# observability.TraceSummary

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A trace of an agent or workflow run with its tokens, cost and status.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `observability.TraceSummary` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.trace.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agentId` | yes | `none` | Agent of the root span, if any. |  |
| `costMicroUsd` | yes | `none` | Cost in micro-USD; null when a model price is unknown. |  |
| `durationMs` | yes | `none` | Duration in milliseconds; null while running. |  |
| `inputTokens` | yes | `none` | Prompt tokens. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Root span name (agent or workflow run). |  |
| `outputTokens` | yes | `none` | Completion tokens. |  |
| `spanCount` | yes | `none` | Number of spans. |  |
| `startedAt` | yes | `none` | Start (UTC). |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `error` when any span failed. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization of the trace; null for platform jobs. |  |
| `traceId` | yes | `none` | Trace id. |  |
| `workflowId` | yes | `none` | Workflow of the root span, if any. |  |
